VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_ASTROLABE.title: Origin Astrolabe
VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_ASTROLABE.descripti: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{Margin}[/blue] Margin. The first time each combat [gold]Life Calculation[/gold] triggers, [gold]Dimension Up[/gold] the leftmost card in your hand.
VIVHITE_RELIC_ORIGIN_ASTROLABE.flavor: Its nested rings always return to the same origin, no matter how many dimensions unfold between them.
